text: An attractor that is bounded yet has a positive Lyapunov exponent and fractal (non-integer) dimension - like the Lorenz attractor (dimension ~ 2.06) - is called a ___ attractor.
explanation: The text defines a strange attractor as one that is neither a fixed point, limit cycle, nor torus, exhibits sensitive dependence (lambda_max > 0), and typically has fractal dimension - exactly the Lorenz attractor.
